verdict.rationale: Scribe's batch mode handles large-scale parallel transcription: a single job can cover up to 10,000 files (or 1,000 from a manifest), and files are processed independently. Jobs move through a documented lifecycle that starts with a QUEUED state, with list, status, cancel and per-file endpoints. However, nothing in the evidence documents concurrency limits, rate limits, or how jobs are queued and scheduled beyond the existence of the QUEUED state. missing for 10: documented concurrency/rate limits (max concurrent jobs or requests), explicit queueing/scheduling behavior, limits on parallel synchronous or live sessions, independent corroboration
